title: Scalable Transformers for Quantum Chemistry Surface Hopping
abstract: We present a non-adiabatic molecular dynamics framework utilizing attention-based neural operators. Our method achieves a 42x speedup over ab-initio CASSCF simulations while maintaining chemical accuracy within 0.04 eV across 10,000 trajectories.

title: Self-Supervised Genomic Foundation Models in Rare Variant Pathogenicity
abstract: Interpreting non-coding variants remains challenging in precision oncology. Here we train a 3-billion parameter DNA transformer on 1,000 human genomes. The model outperforms CADD and AlphaMissense with an AUROC of 0.94 on ClinVar benchmark sets.
